extension.summary: 9Movies — TMDB-powered Movies & TV with HdHub streams
extension.description: Browse thousands of Movies and TV Shows via TMDB — New Releases, Trending, Oscar Winners, Popular, Most Watched, Top Box Office, Blockbusters, Genres, Years. TV: Trending, Popular, Premieres, Most Watched, Airing Today, Upcoming, Genres, Networks. Streams sourced from the HdHub library in 4K, 1080p and 720p with Hindi and English audio.
extension.disclaimer: This addon uses publicly accessible APIs. Use at your own risk.
extension.news:
v2.5.1 - MOVIE DETAIL: Renamed rows to "Find Link", "Trailer", "Extras", "Recommended", "Similar To", "Add to Favourites". InfoTag title now matches each button label so skins no longer replace them with the movie title. Each row has its own placeholder icon in resources/lib/media/.
v2.5.0 - LINK PICKER: Stream rows now show quality tags only (e.g. "4K | REMUX | DTS | 5.1 | PixelDrain"), no movie/show title. - DOWNLOADS: New "Download" context menu on every link — actually saves the file to disk in the background with start/complete toast notifications. - My Downloads: New top-level menu item that lists every downloaded file, playable directly. Includes "Delete" context menu. - SETTINGS: Configurable Downloads folder under a new Downloads category. - ICONS: New resources/lib/media/ folder with placeholder PNGs for every main menu and submenu item — drop in your own art to replace them.
v2.0.0 - COMPLETE REWRITE: Now powered by TMDB for browsing and HdHub Stremio addon for streams. - MOVIES menu: New Releases, Trending, Oscar Winners, Popular, Most Watched, Top Box Office, Blockbusters, Genres (19 genres), Years (1980-2025). - TV SHOWS menu: Trending, Popular, Premieres, Most Watched, Airing Today, Upcoming, Genres (13 genres), Networks (17 major networks). - Full Season and Episode picker for TV shows. - Streams labelled with quality, audio language, server and file size. - Search across movies and TV shows simultaneously. - TMDB posters, backdrops, ratings and descriptions for every title. - Settings simplified — no API keys exposed to users.
